title: Unable to load Thunderbird
creator: alison.shepherd
content:
I am unable to access my emails in Thunderbird. Thunderbird opened but does not respond as there appear to be some files /emails that it could not accessed.

I tried deleting the Parent.lock file. I then deleted Thunderbird and re-installed it.

On opening the updated instance, it comes up with the same couple of files/emails in the list. With the same ones seemingly trying to be loaded. See attachment. The files are Invoice 03-10-20 and Ticket_1.pdf

title: Startup - Avvio automatico
creator: brunetti.luigino
content: Uso windows 10. Ho provato in vari modi. Ho inserito il link nella cartella esecuzione automatica e ho settato il flag nelle app avvio di windws facendo varie prove. In un primo momento thunderbird si avvia con il pc ma dopo una o due accensioni del pc il flag avvio app in windows si resetta e non funziona più avvio automatico. Grazie.
